beats.speaker: aldric
beats.text: Letters. On my own road. I read nine of them at the waystation and could not stop.

beats.speaker: aldric
beats.text: This one is my daughter's paw. Father, the Hall is very quiet. Mother walks the long gallery and pretends to count the silver. Come home.

beats.speaker: aldric
beats.text: I will read the rest. Then I will see about the road home.

beats.speaker: aldric
beats.text: You. The wolf who walked my road. Ten letters, carried out to me where I was hiding in my work.

beats.speaker: maren
beats.text: Scales and silver, he is home and standing in his own gateway. Do you know how long I have waited to see that?

beats.speaker: aldric
beats.text: In front of my lady, then: thank you. I will not forget whose paws carried them.

beats.speaker: solveig
beats.text: These are the wharf's drowned, as their kin gave them to me. A crane hand. A lighterman off the Mole. A rope hand on the hoists.

beats.speaker: solveig
beats.text: A bale counter on the Grayrock quay. And one who could whistle louder than the Bay Light.

beats.speaker: aldric
beats.text: I paid for the buryings and nothing else. I will stand here while every one of them is read.

beats.speaker: solveig
beats.text: Then the tide has been answered. Bright One keep them, and keep us who are left.

beats.speaker: gorm
beats.text: Black cloaks at the Pass House. Yes, I wrote to them. By salt and water, someone had to.

beats.speaker: gorm
beats.text: In Saltwell, when I was young, a pup the water obeyed drowned a well, and herself with it. Nobody had taught her.

beats.speaker: gorm
beats.text: By the Concord's custom the Envoy speaks only through me. Walk her down the Pass Road, and she will hear this realm kindly.

beats.speaker: aldric
beats.text: I have read every letter. My daughter's were the heaviest. I will sit with the Council now, and stay sat.

beats.speaker: gerrit
beats.text: By the forge and the sea, a full table at last. Sit, my lord. The roll has waited for you.

quests.title: A Letter for the Lord
quests.summary: Forty wolves of the city carry a letter for Lord Grayrock, who is never home. Do one of them a kindness and take their letter, or carry his daughter Ingrid's, and give it to him.

objectives.label: Give Lord Grayrock a letter: one a carrier gave you for a kindness, or Ingrid Grayrock's own.

rewards.text: You carried a letter home to its lord. The city has thirty-nine more like it.

quests.title: Every Week, a Letter
quests.summary: Ingrid Grayrock writes to her father every week. Carry this week's letter to him, then tell her what you found.

offer.ask: Is that a letter for your father?
offer.say: #greet#. I write to him every week. He never answers. Would you carry this one? He will be on a road somewhere. He always is.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Whatever he said, you came back and told me. That is more than the road ever did.
offer.during: Did you find him? He will be at the Wharf Office, or on a road that leads away from it.

objectives.label: Give Ingrid's letter to her father.
Tell Ingrid what you found, the truth or a kindness.

rewards.detail: carried a daughter's letter to Lord Grayrock

rewards.text: #greet#. You came back. Nobody comes back from Father's roads but Father, and not often him.

quests.title: News of Larkfield
quests.summary: Lady Maren was raised in Larkfield. Carry her word to the linen looms there, and bring her back a twist of Larkdowns thyme.

offer.ask: You look a long way from home, my lady.
offer.say: #greet#. You will be going out past Larkfield? Take my word to the loom master there, and bring me back a twist of thyme off the downs. Only a twist. Scales and silver, I would trade a ship for it.
offer.accept: A word for the looms, and thyme for you.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. It smells of home. I'd forgotten home had a smell.
offer.during: The thyme grows on the Larkdowns swells, where the sheep do not crop it. Mind the loom master talks your ear off.

objectives.label: Give Lady Maren's message to the loom master at Larkfield.
Gather thyme on the Larkdowns.
Give Lady Maren a twist of thyme.

rewards.detail: brought a twist of Larkdowns thyme to Grayrock Hall

quests.title: The Names on the Water
quests.summary: The priest of the Chapel of the Tide wants the names of the wharf drowned, from those who lost them, so they can be read before Lord Grayrock.

offer.say: #greet#. The wharf has drowned wolves nobody ever read out. Ask their kin for them, gently. Then bring them, and the lord, to the chapel.
offer.decline: I could not ask that of anyone.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. They will be read, every one. The tide keeps no list; now we do.
offer.during: Ask among the wharf families. The sergeant of the Watch lost a brother, and the printers at the Council Press, and the Grantham boy.

objectives.label: Ask the families of the wharf drowned for their names: five of them, each in their own words.
Speak to Lord Grayrock: the names are ready to be read.

rewards.detail: gathered the names of the wharf drowned

rewards.text: #greet#. Every name you brought me was read. Bright One keep you for carrying them.

quests.title: What Nan Is Saving For
quests.summary: The quarrymaster has saved for years to buy the quarry folk their common right in the Rainward Hills. Help her raise the last of it.

offer.say: #greet#. Saving for something. Maybe it is this: the common right in the hills, for the quarry folk, before Fell buys the lot. Three good stones to sell, and a word from the salon, and it is ours.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Bought. Whatever the Council does with the hills, the quarry folk have their right now.
offer.during: The salon is Lady Celestine's, in Greatly House. Ask her plainly. She likes that, though she will not say so.

objectives.label: Give the quarrymaster three stones.
Ask Lady Celestine at her salon to speak for the common right.

rewards.detail: helped the quarry folk buy their common right

rewards.text: #greet#. The quarry folk's right is bought and pinned up over my bed. That was your doing as much as mine.

quests.title: A Berth for Julian
quests.summary: Julian Greatly wants a berth on the Grey Tern for spring. Ask at the Sailors' Rest, then tell him.

offer.ask: You keep looking at the harbour.
offer.say: #greet#. The Grey Tern wants hands for spring. Ask at the Sailors' Rest if there is a berth for a clerk who can count. Do not say which House.
offer.accept: I'll ask at the Sailors' Rest.
offer.decline: Your House would never forgive me.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Spring, then. Somebody in this family ought to see where all those cargoes in the ledgers go.

objectives.label: Ask at the Sailors' Rest about a berth on the Grey Tern.
Tell Julian there is a berth.

quests.title: Corwin's Wager
quests.summary: Corwin Fell will wager the hills against anyone at the table in the Knucklebones. Beat the table, and he sends you into Fellhall on an errand.

offer.ask: They say you like a wager.
offer.say: #greet#. A wager, then. The table at the Knucklebones, any game you like. Win, and I'll send you into Fellhall on an errand, to see how the other half drinks.
offer.thanks: Ha. Beaten by a road wolf. Go on up to Fellhall, then, and fetch my ledger from upstairs. Don't read it.

objectives.label: Take up the wager.
Win a game at the table in the Knucklebones.

rewards.detail: beat a Fell lord at his own table

rewards.text: Corwin sends you up into Fellhall on an errand: fetch his ledger from the rooms upstairs.

quests.title: The Reluctant Heir
quests.summary: Lord Grayrock is still not home, and his son may have to cast the House vote at the Moot. He wants to know how a vote is weighed.

offer.ask: Your father is still on the road?
offer.say: #greet#. If Father does not come home, I am the House, and the House has a vote at the Moot. I keep the wharf's books. Nobody ever taught me how a vote is weighed.
offer.accept: I'll ask the Speaker, and come back.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. I think I could stand up in that room now. I would still rather be at the forge.

objectives.label: Ask the Speaker of the Council how a House vote is weighed.
Tell Tobias how it is weighed.

rewards.detail: taught a reluctant heir how a House vote is weighed

quests.title: Gudrun's Letter
quests.summary: A sealed letter in Gudrun Fell's paw, left on the accounts table at Fellhall: she proposes a match with the Timberland heir. What you do with it settles more than a wedding.

objectives.label: Deliver it to the Timberland heir, show it to the head of House Fell, or burn it and tell Gudrun.

rewards.detail: settled what became of a sealed Fellhall letter

quests.title: The Lamp-keeper's Letter
quests.summary: Dagfinn carries his own letter for Lord Grayrock: a toll receipt, with the old King's note on its back. He wants the wolf who has done most for the letters to carry it.

objectives.label: Give the lamp-keeper's letter to Lord Grayrock.

rewards.detail: carried the lamp-keeper's own letter to Lord Grayrock

quests.title: Fell Wine for the Stewards
quests.summary: The Counting House sends a sealed flask of Fell wine to the Grayrock steward, with its compliments. Nobody asks what the compliments buy.

offer.ask: Any errands for the Counting House?
offer.say: #greet#. A flask of Fell wine for the Grayrock steward, with the Counting House's compliments. Carry it, and the House pays its own.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. The House remembers who carries for it. So does the Sump, I hear.

objectives.label: Give the flask to the Grayrock steward.

quests.title: The Late Howl
quests.summary: This town's gathering howl was never found. Ask its Keeper to howl it with you, and answer the Keeper's howl: a chorus at last.

objectives.label: Ask the town's Keeper to howl it with you, then howl along within the hour.

rewards.detail: howled a town's lost howl with its Keeper

quests.title: Walk the Envoy Down
quests.summary: The Concord's Envoy is at the Pass House and wants walking down to the city: the Frosthollow square, the Upper Mere post, the Glasswater relay, the Ridgemere waystation.

objectives.label: Meet her at the Pass House, and walk her to the Frosthollow square.
Walk her to the Upper Mere post.
Walk her to the Glasswater relay.
Walk her to the Ridgemere waystation.

rewards.detail: walked the Concord's envoy down the Pass Road
